newsitem.title: FRANCE: ABN Amro France to take 80 pct of Demachy Worms.
newsitem.headline: ABN Amro France to take 80 pct of Demachy Worms.

text.p: Dutch bank ABN Amro's French unit has signed an agreement with Worms & Cie to take an 80 percent stake in bank Demachy Worms & Cie, ABN Amro and Worms said in a joint statement on Tuesday.

"This agreement will allow the bank, with the backing of a first rank international bank group, to pursue its development while preserving its identity under the name of Banque Demachy," said the statement.
The two had said in December they were in talks.
Demachy Worms specialises in private banking, custody and has some asset management and corporate banking activities.
The agreement should be finalised by the end of June, an ABN Amro spokesman said.
He declined to give the amount of the transaction.
